NMSIS source subset for PicoRV32 32-point Q15 CFFT

Upstream: https://github.com/Nuclei-Software/NMSIS
Pinned commit: dc728b988b6562868d311a2e14b5d9f8ebbd26b0
Download date: 2026-11-06 (Asia/Shanghai)
License: Apache-2.0; see the unmodified upstream LICENSE and file headers.

This directory is a library source subset, not a complete NMSIS checkout.
All imported upstream files are byte-for-byte unchanged. Each file was checked
against the Git blob SHA in the recursive tree of the pinned commit.

Selection:
- Complete NMSIS/DSP/Include directory, recursively.
- Complete NMSIS/Core/Include directory, recursively.
- Seven DSP C files listed in MANIFEST.tsv.
- Root LICENSE.

Compile include paths relative to this directory:
  NMSIS/DSP/Include
  NMSIS/Core/Include

Target configuration:
  -march=rv32imc -mabi=ilp32
  -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections
  Link with -Wl,--gc-sections and preserve the firmware startup entry/section.
  The CPU configuration must support M and C when using rv32imc.
  Do not enable RISCV_MATH_DSP, RVV, Nuclei DSP extension macros, or hard-float.
  Do not define RISCV_DSP_CONFIG_TABLES: this release explicitly rejects it.
  Use riscv_cfft_init_32_q15 to allow unused tables to be discarded.

The application must supply startup, memory placement, and output routines.
This subset does not supply a PicoRV32 platform layer or C standard library.
